artworks.title: Saint Mary Magdalene Pray for Us
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hubert and Michèle Prouté and Family, in memory of Jean Adhémar and Paul Prouté, and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring Saint Mary Magdalene praying. Mary Magdalene is depicted in a contemplative state, resting her head on one hand, while holding a small crucifix in the other. She is surrounded by colorful angels, with one angel holding a cloth and another in prayer. In the background, there is a small church on a hilltop with a flag. The painting is framed with floral and ribbon motifs and includes the text "SAINTE-MARIE-MADELEINE PRIEZ POUR NOUS." The style is reminiscent of French folk art.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist Pray for Us
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hubert and Michèle Prouté and Family, in memory of Jean Adhémar and Paul Prouté, and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows the upper three-quarters of a person standing, with their torso, left leg, and right leg partially hidden behind draped fabric. The person is upright, with their right arm raised and their left arm holding a staff. Their face has defined features within a stylized halo of red and yellow stripes. They have long, wavy hair, a layered garment, and a fur mantle. At their feet is a small goat. The background features an elaborate decorative frame with floral motifs, a blue, red, and gold border, and stylized grass and flowers. Above the figure are smaller figures within a circle, each with a halo. There is decorative text at the bottom, framed by floral elements.

artworks.title: Chancellor Pierre Seguier
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a man's upper body and head within an ornate oval border. He is depicted sitting upright, with his head slightly turned to the left. The man has facial hair, a narrow face, medium-length, dark, curly hair, and wears formal attire with a cross pendant around his neck. The oval frame has intricate patterns and flowers, all rendered in monochrome.

artworks.title: Peasant Family in an Interior wtih the Father Feeding a Child
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.9 × 9.5 cm (5 1/16 × 3 3/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene of a rustic dwelling. The room is crowded with various elements common in a humble domestic setting. To the left, there is a bunk bed made with simple bedding and a partially visible object resting on top. Below it, a small figure is seated beside a wooden table with utensils. In the foreground, another figure is seated on a stool, with an object in hand, while another figure stands or leans behind them, partially draped in fabric. To the side hangs a cooking pot, indicating the presence of a hearth or cooking space. Several objects like tools or sticks are scattered on the ground, adding to the cluttered atmosphere. The artist uses detailed hatching and cross-hatching to create depth and texture, emphasizing the rustic quality of the interior.

artworks.title: Street Vendor Selling Spectacles at the Door
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a merchant interacting with two individuals at the entrance of a rustic dwelling. The scene shows a figure dressed in a large hat and cloak, possibly a merchant, carrying a basket filled with objects and holding up a pair of spectacles. One of the individuals, positioned in the doorway, appears to be engaging with the merchant, while another smaller figure stands nearby, possibly a child or someone of shorter stature, leaning against the doorframe. The setting is an outdoor rural environment, with a stone or brick wall of the building, thatched roofing overhead. The composition captures details such as the texture of the clothing, the wicker basket, and the lines of the wooden and masonry structures.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Solomon
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 5 x 7.6 cm (1 15/16 x 3 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts several figures in a detailed scene. There is a seated man on the right, wearing a fur-collared robe and a crown, and holding a staff. To his left, another man stands upright holding a child, with short hair and a pointed beard, wearing simple clothing and a cloak. Two women are partially visible on the left, one kneeling and the other standing, both wearing long dresses with visible hair caps. The kneeling woman has her face inclined upward, while the standing woman looks toward the seated man. In the foreground, a baby lies wrapped on the ground. The background shows an architectural setting with a large column, and a glimpse of an outdoor scene with a tree and a tower in the distance. The setting suggests an indoor court-like space with drapery hanging above the figures.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Gentleman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man with wavy hair, sharp eyebrows, and a straight nose, wearing armor and a white cloth near his neck. The bust-length portrait is set within an ornate oval frame with a decorative background of floral motifs and baroque elements. Below the portrait are various symbolic items, including a lion's face, scrolls, an upturned vessel, and draped fabric. In the background, a bas-relief shows an ancient battle scene with soldiers and a fortified city.

artworks.title: Algernon Percy, Earl of Northumberland
artworks.artist: Jacobus Houbraken after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is an engraving. It features a portrait of a person viewed from the torso upwards, set within an ornate oval frame. The individual is positioned slightly angled to the left while facing the viewer. They have facial features including a mustache and wavy hair that reaches just below the ears. The person wears a dark garment with a high collar and may be draped with a robe or cloak. Surrounding the oval frame are elaborate carved embellishments, and a cherubic figure sits at the bottom right, looking upwards and holding decorative foliage. Beneath this figure, sailing ships are etched into the lower section of the carved frame. In the background, detailed engraving work embellishes the image with intricate patterns and shapes.

artworks.title: James, Earl of Morton
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image displays an engraving of a man from the chest up, facing slightly to his right. He has a full beard and mustache, wears a broad-brimmed hat, and a leather doublet with a high-collar. He is framed within an oval frame with draped fabric, and the background is plain. Engraved text within the frame identifies him as James, Earl of Morton.

artworks.title: William Trumbull
artworks.artist: George Vertue after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.2 x 20.2 cm (11 1/2 x 7 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He is seated with his body facing slightly to the left while his head is turned toward the viewer, creating a three-quarter view. The man has long, curly hair that extends past his shoulders, a prominent nose, and calm eyes. He is wearing a dark, long-sleeved garment with a white cravat around his neck. The background features an ornate frame with an oval shape enclosing the portrait and a rectangular plaque below it identifying him as Sir William Trumbull, Principal Secretary of State to King William III.

artworks.title: Pierre Mignard
artworks.artist: Cornelis Vermeulen after Pierre Mignard I
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 43.3 x 34.9 cm (17 1/16 x 13 3/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man. He is holding a large book or portfolio with both hands. He has long, curly hair and distinctive facial features, wearing a robe over a shirt with lace cuffs. The portrait is encased in an oval frame with inscriptions and decorative elements, including a coat of arms. The background has fine linear detailing.

artworks.title: Pierre Ignace de Braux
artworks.artist: Peter Ludwig van Schuppen after Henri Beaubrun
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with a composed expression, looking directly at the viewer. He has long, curly hair and is wearing historical formal attire with a large, white collar and voluminous sleeves. The background features an ornate, octagonal frame with decorative leaf-like elements. Below the portrait is an elaborate coat of arms, flanked by two figures, and inscriptive text.

artworks.title: Hendrik Casimir II, Count of Nassau-Dietz
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a male figure from the chest upward. He is facing forward, looking directly at the viewer. The man has distinct facial features with slightly arched eyebrows and a prominent nose. He has long, dark, curly hair that falls past his shoulders. He is wearing an ornate lace cravat around his neck, standing out against his dark armor. The armor is detailed with studs and decorative patterns. The background features an oval frame around the figure, set against a plain backdrop, giving the portrait a classic and formal appearance.

artworks.title: Johan de Wit
artworks.artist: Abraham Blooteling after Pieter van der Banck
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 27.1 x 21.8 cm (10 11/16 x 8 9/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an oval portrait of a man facing slightly to one side. He has long, curly hair, a moustache, and a composed expression. The man is wearing a dark coat with a high collar, adorned with a decorative button at the neck, and a white shirt underneath. The background is plain and dark, emphasizing the man's face and attire.

artworks.title: The Martyr of Equality
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a man holding a severed head in one hand and a decorative hat in the other, standing in front of a guillotine. The man is detailed with light-colored hair, facial features showing a slight smirk, wearing a blue military-style jacket with yellow epaulettes, white breeches, knee-high boots, and a sash with "EGALITÉ" written on it. A man sits slumped to the left with his head on a block and a pile of pink liquid below. In the background, a crowd armed with pikes is visible, with buildings and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Clio
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated against a tree, extending her right arm. She has distinct facial features, earrings, and styled hair with adornments. She wears an elaborate gown with textured sleeves, a high lace ruffled collar, and a long skirt. Stacked books are beside her, one labeled "LIVIVS." In the background, there are trees on the left and a scene of a battle on the right. The circular border includes inscriptions in a classical style.

artworks.title: Interior of a Kitchen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 15 x 20.2 cm (5 7/8 x 7 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a skinned animal carcass hanging on the left side. Two figures, a man and a woman, are positioned behind it. The woman appears to be leaning forward, as if handling an object. The color palette is primarily sepia with varying tones of brown and beige. On the right side, there are various produce and kitchen items, such as a basket of vegetables, a cabbage, and different pots and containers. In the foreground, there are more kitchenware and clothing items, creating a cluttered scene on a raised surface. Above this area, there are a few bottles and a bowl with a duck-shaped object in the background.

artworks.title: The Cat's Concert
artworks.artist: Coryn Boel after David Teniers the Younger
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.8 x 31.4 cm (9 3/8 x 12 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: Printed in black and gray tones against cream-white paper, three cats, three kittens, two monkeys, and an owl gather on and around a dining table in this horizontal etching and engraving. A round-topped table is covered by a white cloth at the center of the composition. The pedestal-style legs have feet carved to look like sleepy fish. Three cats and three smaller kittens sit on the table and presumably sing, their mouths open, around a music book. An owl with brushy, feathery brows perches on the top of the book, which is propped up on the table. A seventh cat peers through a rectangular opening in the wall to our left, looking down on the scene. Two monkeys hunch together in the lower right corner. One wears a floppy cap with a feather, the other a hooded robe, and that second one plays a horn instrument. Two lutes, a bagpipe, and another horn instrument are clustered in the lower right corner of the sheet around a book titled “TENOR.” Text inscribed in the plate near the lower left corner reads, “D Teniers In et excud. cum privilegio” and one to the right reads, “Cory Boel. f.”

artworks.title: Section of the Church of Saint John the Baptist
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural elevation and section view of a domed building. The image presents two distinct halves side by side. The left half shows the external elevation of the building with detailed outlines of windows, cornices, and the dome exterior, while the right half offers an internal sectional view highlighting structural details like arches, columns, and decorative wall panels inside the dome. Both perspectives are aligned at the central axis of the dome. The drawing includes fine linework detailing elements like the texture of the dome's surface, window frames, and brickwork. The top of the image is labeled with text, possibly referencing the architectural subject and the architect, indicating an intention to provide a precise and informative depiction of the design.

artworks.title: Ground Plan of the Church of Saint John the Baptist
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a floor plan for a building. The drawing features an architectural plan of a symmetrical structure with multiple semi-circular alcoves around a central open space. The alcoves contain various geometric shapes, possibly representing walls and columns. The edges of the alcoves are ornamented with rectilinear and circular shapes suggesting structural details like arches or pillars. There is text at the top of the drawing that provides information about the building's purpose and architectural attribution.

artworks.title: Moses Brought to Pharaoh's Daughter
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures in various poses. A woman is seated on the left, turned to the right, with composed facial features and styled hair. She wears a flowing gown. Next to her, an older man and a younger woman stand, facing her. The man has a beard and wears a hat, while the woman holds small objects. A child stands between them, looking at the seated woman. The child has curly hair and is barefoot. In the background are architectural elements like columns, a curtain, and distant buildings, creating a classical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Design for a Baldaquin
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural structure. The image shows a detailed architectural design of an ornate archway or facade adorned with classical elements. The structure displays symmetrical columns with Corinthian capitals supporting an entablature, topped by a dome-like structure with decorative finials. The base of the structure includes a series of steps leading up to the archway, and intricate details such as cornices and ornamental accents are drawn with precision. The architectural line work suggests a focus on neoclassical design principles, emphasizing the elegance and balance typical of this style. The attention to proportions and decorative elements highlights the draftsman's skill in architectural rendering.

artworks.title: Design for a Catafalque
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural structure. The drawing depicts a detailed elevation of a decorative architectural element, possibly a pedestal or an altar, featuring classical motifs reminiscent of neoclassical design. The structure is symmetrical, with a series of steps leading to a large base. Above this base are rounded and rectangular sections adorned with intricate molding and classical embellishments, including scrolls and urn shapes. An ornate wreath encircles a central circular element near the upper middle section, flanked by fluted columns and elaborate scrolling patterns. The design is drawn with precise, thin lines on a light background, indicating a technical and careful approach typical in architectural plans or concept drawings.

artworks.title: The Tomb of Death
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 13.5 x 18.4 cm (5 5/16 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henry and Judith Rice Millon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures standing on either side of a dark archway. On the left, a nude figure with long hair is entwined with a serpent. Beside them is a reptilian creature. On the right, a figure draped in robes and crowned with a circlet of spikes holds a spear. The background shows a stone structure with dark shadows. Billowing clouds of smoke or mist frame the entire composition.
